title: Skeniranje ranjivosti
summary: Program skeniranja ranjivosti: asset inventory, planiranje (raspored, performanse, osjetljivost, segmentacija, regulativa), internal/external, agent/agentless, credentialed/non-credentialed, passive/active, discovery (mapping, fingerprinting) i baseline skeniranje prema PCI DSS, CIS i ISO 27000.
summary_en: A vulnerability scanning program: asset inventory, planning (scheduling, performance, sensitivity, segmentation, regulations), internal/external, agent/agentless, credentialed/non-credentialed, passive/active, discovery (mapping, fingerprinting), and baseline scanning against PCI DSS, CIS, and ISO 27000.
